 Introduction 
 Patrick 
Today, we will be covering the endlessly fascinating market of space. While we typically focus on an individual company for Business Breakdowns, we thought an industry primer was the best approach for this expanding market with Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos directing so much energy to the promise of space, it is impossible not to dream about what lies ahead. To cover this endless topic, I'll be joined by a previous guest, Tren Griffin. While Tren's full-time job is as a director at Microsoft, his experience with satellites and endless curiosity make him ideal for this conversation. We cover issues like how our ground economy is enabled by space today, what excites him most about the space to space opportunities in the future, and how space compares to other network foundations. I hope you enjoy this great space primer with Tren Griffin.

 The Extraterrestrial Economy
